summary: 09:15 ET Week 3 refresh: Christian Watson anytime TD remains PRIME's only actionable current Week 3 player-prop candidate, but no user-facing action changes. A directly opened DraftKings Network player-props page, which states its displayed props update every five minutes and links to DraftKings Sportsbook betslips, showed Watson +150 at this checkpoint, down from the prior archive's direct +160. A separate same-day WagerLens market page said its data were updated seven minutes earlier and listed Fanatics +155 as the best available Watson anytime-TD price. CLEATZ still displayed Fanatics +165 / DraftKings +160 but exposes no upstream sportsbook timestamp, and a fresh DraftKings Network search-cache result also conflicted at +160. PRIME therefore treats +150 DraftKings and +155 Fanatics as the freshest independently verifiable public references while preserving executable sportsbook-app truth as controlling. With the stored 47.0% fair TD probability, +155 implies 39.22% and a 7.78-point edge; +150 implies 40.0% and a 7.0-point edge. Both are in the 6-8% bucket, down from the prior archive's 8%+ best-market state, but the recommendation remains 0.5u only if unplaced and only at +135 or better. Official final injury designations remain unchanged, Lambeau weather remains benign, no additional correlated Green Bay exposure is approved, no second Week 3 prop clears PRIME's full quality gate, and no Week 3 user ticket is recorded.
